task.description: The address of the task, for example @v1/nuucognition/task/<id>#ops.

steps.title: Task Object
steps.next: Read the task with ops task show {{task}} --json, and its task note (a task with no note gets one: flint shard task task-new --ops {{task}}). Add it as an object before the first edit: flint orbh objects add {{task}} --subscribe. Set doing when it is todo: ops task start {{task}}. Then run flint shard task task-sync {{task}}.

next.interactive: Do the work of {{task}}. Make each step that serves its intent a subtask in Strike. Follow the WIP commit rule of knw-task-commits, and keep each commit as <sha> (<repo>) for the result.
next.headless: Set the phase implementing. Do the work of {{task}}, and keep the progress current. Follow the WIP commit rule of knw-task-commits, and keep each commit as <sha> (<repo>) for the result. When blocked, use a deferred request.

steps.title: Result
steps.next: Write the result with ops task result {{task}} '<what the work gave>. Tests: <…>. Commits: <sha> (<repo>), …. Session: <ORBH_SESSION_ID>'. Then run flint shard task task-sync {{task}}.

next.interactive: Give the person the summary of {{task}}. The review comes next in a second session: flint shard invoke task review_task --input task={{task}}. Toward the review now: skip the step close, and close the invocation with --outcome done.
next.headless: Set the phase complete. Mark this step done, and close the invocation: flint shard invocations close {{invocation}} --outcome done. Put the review_task command of the close in the result. When no parent frame is open, return with flint orbh session return --finish. When the close prints back in: (a parent frame is open), do not return: continue the parent frame.

steps.title: Close
steps.next: When the person confirms, close the task with sk-task-close_task: ops task close {{task}}, then flint shard task task-sync {{task}}. Keep the result: it names the commits. When the person wants the review first, skip this step with a reason, and close the invocation with --outcome done.

behaviours.say: Add the task as an object before the first edit: flint orbh objects add {{task}} --subscribe
Before the return: write the result of {{task}}, with each commit as <sha> (<repo>) and the session. Then run flint shard task task-sync {{task}}. Put the review_task command in the result.
